title: Create curves, ropes, arches, and stairs
summary: Use the Geometry inspector to make shaped world surfaces and edit their controls.
outcome: A new curved patch, rope, arch, or stair shape is placed and ready for inspection.

sections.title: Create shaped geometry

steps.title: Open the geometry tool
steps.text: Choose Create > Curves, ropes, arches and stairs…. Pick Curved patch, Bevel, End cap, Cylinder, Solid arch, or Stairs.

steps.title: Set bounds
steps.text: Enter center and width, depth, and height, or select a brush and click Use selection bounds. Set segments and arch thickness where those fields apply.

steps.title: Create and check
steps.text: Choose the active material, then click the Create button named for the selected shape. Inspect the result in Camera. If Replace selected brush is enabled, confirm the original brush was intentionally replaced; Undo restores the previous map.

tips: A curved patch is a surface. Use Solid arch or Stairs when you need their generated solid shape.

sections.title: Edit a curved patch

steps.title: Select the curve
steps.text: Select a curved patch to expose Edit curve. Refine rows or columns to gain more controls without changing its shape.

steps.title: Move its controls
steps.text: In the Geometry inspector, choose Column and Row and click Select control, Select column, Select row, or All controls. Enter Control X/Y/Z and click Apply control position, or use Vertex mode and transform handles in a view.

steps.title: Weld or protect controls
steps.text: With patch controls selected, use Modify > Patch control points > Weld to move selected points to their shared center. Lock protects selected controls for this editing session; Unlock releases them when you need to edit again.

steps.title: Finish its edges
steps.text: Use Flip facing if the front side points the wrong way. Cap ends fills applicable bevel, end cap, or cylinder ends; Split curve divides a chosen span while keeping shape and texture continuous.

steps.title: Convert if necessary
steps.text: Convert curve to terrain creates editable terrain at chosen detail. Thicken curve makes a closed terrain shell behind its front side; Undo returns to the editable curve controls.

tips: If Weld is unavailable, select at least two unlocked patch controls. Unlock before moving a protected control.

sections.title: Create a rope between markers

steps.title: Place endpoints
steps.text: Create two temporary info_null markers and select both. Choose the rope material in the browser.

steps.title: Generate the rope
steps.text: In Rope between two points, set thickness, slack, and segments, then click Create rope. The result is editable visual terrain and does not collide.

tips: If the markers remain, check that exactly two temporary info_null markers are selected. Named or linked markers are not consumed. Undo brings consumed markers back.
